issues.desc: background.md Key Insights and Solution Tradeoffs sections use Tier-A, Tier-B, and Tier-C without any inline definition. A standalone reader (no conversation history, no paper context) cannot determine what each tier means from the background text alone.

background.md uses C2 (in Key Insights: the paper's C2 data proof; in Conversational Texture: paper's evidence-gating-spine section (C2)) as a section identifier with no inline expansion or definition. A standalone reader cannot determine what C2 refers to.
